# Canada Pharmacy Online

> > CIPA-certified Canadian pharmacy offering prescription medications, pet medications, and international drug fulfillment with over 73,000 customer reviews since 2006.

Canada Pharmacy Online operates as Candrug Pharmacy in Surrey, British Columbia, licensed by the College of Pharmacists of BC. The pharmacy specializes in discount prescription drugs including popular medications like Cialis, Viagra, Eliquis, Xarelto, Farxiga, Flovent, and Myrbetriq, serving customers through their online platform with prescription refill services and comprehensive customer support.
